data.title: Adam funds Autodesk founders and the entire Artemis development environment

actions.description: Late-January founders agreement, selected scenario day after the 30 January organizing meeting. Adam supplies each assigned developer an Artemis PRO, the full Team Edition environment, shared build/test/server capacity, qualified storage and backups, toolchains, training and funded engineering support. Begin CAD work using available displays and software graphics fallback; professional 17-inch/800x600 hardware follows around June. November COMDEX is the delivery objective, not a January finished AutoCAD port. Programme details: team_development_program.json.
